text: Reviewed PR #5336 (Studio window size/position test isolation, #1151-1160) via /code-review: one real finding, posted as PR comment. Extraction itself clean -- verified byte-for-byte via GitHub API (Bash down most of this session), all 27 functions moved identically, #include correctly placed, CHANGELOG issue-range matches. The finding: agent-handoff.md's CTest evidence contradicts the PR body's evidence for the same change -- PR body says test_studio_host_json passed 1/1 in 437.72s (matching its own claim the code stays in that aggregate target), but agent-handoff.md says test_studio_host (different target) passed 1/1 in 2.48s (~176x different duration). Looks copy-pasted from a different PR's handoff entry. Worth fixing since agent-handoff.md is the doc the next agent trusts for validation status per CLAUDE.md. Not fixed, your branch.
